refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / travel illustration framing correction.
Edit the supplied calico Eiffel Tower landscape painting. Preserve its cat EXACTLY: natural adult calico, image-left black face and image-right orange, white blaze/chest/paws, amber eyes, pink nose, orange shoulder, black rear-hip, orange-root/black-middle/white-tip tail. Preserve full cat pose, scale, foreground stone path, refined hand-painted style, soft morning lighting, garden colours and 3:2 landscape dimensions.
Only correct the background Eiffel Tower framing: move the tower slightly farther into the scene so the ENTIRE tower, including the complete top antenna and all visible arched feet, fits naturally inside the painting. Leave a clear band of blue sky of at least 6 percent image height ABOVE the antenna tip. Keep the tower centred behind/right of the cat, with recognisable delicate iron lattice, platforms and accurate tapering proportions. Do not simply cut or bend the antenna; draw a complete intact tower at a slightly smaller natural background scale.
Maintain foreground cat as visual protagonist with whole ears/paws/tail in frame. No new objects, people, cats, clothes, labels, text, UI, watermark or border; no digital stretching or collage. This is a single polished coherent painting.
